executive_summary: The South African government has announced plans to invest R24.6 billion in digital transformation initiatives, creating opportunities for AI consulting firms. The energy and mining sectors also present potential opportunities for AI adoption, with companies like Nedbank and MENAR Group considering technology upgrades. Kgotla AI must act quickly to capitalize on these opportunities.
